scope: Pinned source observations; no local connection or execution is implied.

limitations: Shape-key generation includes empty placeholders and heuristic displacements.
rigify_to_vrc reparents original meshes and renames their vertex groups.
vrc_decimate does not establish preserved facial deformation.
vrc_bake_atlas is diffuse-only and can report atlas_created after bake failure.
unity_build_avatar calls pre-build validation callbacks; no bundle is produced by that function.
Helper function names are not evidence of registered MCP tool names.
Geometry helper reads obj.data, not final post-modifier or post-NDMF output.
Review bundle outer success does not guarantee successful nested captures.
Sampling capability tools return descriptions rather than authoring assets.
Prometheus metrics are enabled by default when available; review exposure and logging.
VRChatSDKManager._run_unity_validation returns fixed valid=True, Good and zero counts; it is a stub.
Disk modification uses substring line matching, not identity-aware Unity serialization.
Agentic entrypoint samples a plan without executing the tools.
Upload returncode zero can produce success without avatar_id; no receipt is implied.
Authentication accepts password/TOTP and persists authToken JSON; do not adopt as the FunAvatar default.
Live bridge needs the matching Editor/project; Prometheus metrics are enabled by default when available.
